reviews.text: The best vet in all of Milan! Excellent and competent, one of a kind 👍🏼

We went to the doctor this morning, and the experience was very positive.
They treat you like family, demonstrating great experience and professionalism.
I highly recommend them.
We will be your new clients.

Davide, a wonderful person, very kind, friendly, and extremely knowledgeable. You can tell he has a wealth of experience, but above all, a tremendous love and respect for animals. The doctor who works with him is also very kind and knowledgeable. What can I say? I recently moved here and I can honestly say I've found my TRUSTED vet. 5 stars, but he deserves more.

I had a problem with my cat who was about to give birth, and she was having some pretty serious issues. We did a quick x-ray and found a problem, which was then resolved promptly and quickly; I thought it was very efficient.

Fantastic Vets🥰 …
Davide Corti great professional
Simply the best! Thank you, Dr. Davide from Axel.
The staff is very friendly and competent. You won't find doctors who think about money when they see animals, but people who are willing to help you.

Today, Google suggested I review my old friend Davide, and I realize I've never done so!
Dr. Corti is the best you'll find in the veterinary field. You can search far and wide, but no one will ever understand so quickly and scientifically what's wrong with your four-legged friend. I often remember the dogs he's helped me get back on my feet and the hope he's given me even when there wasn't any.
It's an hour's drive to see him, but it doesn't matter, it's worth it. I know I'll get a realistic, unbiased answer, because Davide is just like that—direct and down-to-earth. He certainly doesn't need my publicity, but I recommend him 100% 💪

Dr. Corti and his entire team are professional, knowledgeable, empathetic, and welcome you with great kindness. I have an 8-year-old English setter, and for both routine checkups and more complex situations, they are skilled at identifying the problem and providing prompt treatment. They don't take appointments, but if you come, they always welcome you.

Dr. Corti is a guarantee for our animals. Thank you always for everything.
